title: Baked Quinoa and Vegetable Patties
subtitle: with leek, mushroom and sweet potato
description: Soft baked patties of quinoa, mushrooms, zucchini, leek and pumpkin bound with egg and hard cheese. Good with sour yoghurt on the side.

steps.text: Cook the quinoa in a pot with the water (or vegetable stock) and salt for about 15 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed. Turn off the heat, place a towel under the lid and leave for about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely dice the vegetables (you can pulse them in a food processor).
Steam the vegetables in a large pan with a little olive oil and a little water or stock for 2-3 minutes, adding 1-2 tablespoons of hot water if they stick. They should stay firm.
Mix the cooked quinoa and the vegetables in a bowl.
Add all the remaining ingredients and mix.
Shape into medium patties and place on a flat tray lined with baking paper.
Bake in a 180°C oven for about 25 minutes or until the patties spring back when touched.
